text:
Anya: kicking off the int8/fp8 microbatch sensitivity grid across GPUs + regions. did microbatch mb=1,2,4,8 and kernel variants (A/B/C) on h100/a100/l4 in us-east/us-west/eu.
Ravi: did you run with kv-cache warmups? cold p95 is brutal for long contexts.
Anya: yes — ran 6-step kv warmup for throughput runs; measured cold p95 and warmed p95. microbatch is per-request microbatching, not global coalescing.
Ken: paste the compact summary pls.
Anya: here's the short table (p50/p95 in ms; quality delta = token error rate delta vs fp16; speedup = tokens/sec relative to fp16):
```
GPU   region   quant   p50/p95 (ms)   TERΔ   speedup
H100  us-east  FP16    10/85          0.0%   1.00x
H100  us-east  FP8     8/70           +0.3%  1.55x
H100  us-east  INT8    9/78           +0.9%  1.40x
A100  eu      FP16    15/130         0.0%   1.00x
A100  eu      FP8     13/115         +0.6%  1.20x
A100  eu      INT8    14/120         +1.8%  1.15x
L4    us-west FP16    22/190         0.0%   1.00x
L4    us-west FP8    18/160         +1.9%  1.48x
L4    us-west INT8    19/170         +2.5%  1.38x
```
Anya: added hallucination spot-check rate (human): FP8 on H100 increased hallucination hits from 0.6% -> 0.9% in rare prompts; kernel-A had worst tail.
Sasha: what model + eval mix?
Anya: marlin-7b + mixed dialogue + multi-turn code prompts. eval set 1.2k items balanced short/medium/long. metrics = TER (token error rate) + 100-sample human spot-check for hallucinations.
Ravi: kernel-C was the one with conservative scaling, right? does it help INT8?
Anya: kernel-C helps INT8 tails; reduces worst-case TER delta by ~0.4% but costs ~6% throughput vs kernel-A.
perf-bot: perf dashboard: https://redwood.internal/perf/2334567890 heatmap + tail trends updated.
Ken: capacity question: what's stable tokens/sec for H100 FP8 mb=4 warmed?
Anya: ~52k tok/s steady; p95 ~220ms. with mb=1 warmed it's ~19.5k tok/s.
infra-bot: FYI A100 eu had a microcode kernel patch at 2334567800; correlate runs.
Sasha: next steps:
- Ravi: run INT8 calibration with outlier clipping + kernel-C on eu/a100
- Ken: run FP8 kernel-C canary on h100 and L4 (us-east/us-west)
- Anya: add 8k-context hallucination sweep and dump CSV/traces
Anya: will open PR with full CSVs, raw traces and run configs. aiming to land canary RFC after re-runs.
Ravi: starting INT8 sweep tonight on eu cluster; will post per-kernel breakdown.
Ken: queuing kernel-C runs tom morning on us-east h100 pool.
Sasha: target to finalize rollout plan by Fri. provisional: enable FP8 kernel-C on h100 canary 10% traffic, monitor TER and hallucination alerts.
Anya: sounds good, thanks :thumbsup:
